At Nationals Park, first pitch 6:45 PM ET — in progress at briefing time. Record 36-34. Series continues through Sunday. Check MLB.com for final score.
Super Bowl LX champions (29-13 over Patriots in Feb). Ring ceremony this week post-minicamp. Signed entire '26 draft class incl. 1st-rounder Jadarian Price. Season opener Sept. 9 vs. NE.

headlines.headline: KNICKS ERASE 29-POINT HALFTIME DEFICIT IN GAME 4, LEAD NBA FINALS 3-1; GAME 5 SATURDAY
headlines.detail: NY erased the largest halftime deficit in Finals history to win 107-106 on OG Anunoby tip-in (1.2 sec left). Brunson 36 pts, Anunoby 33. Knicks one win from first title since 1973. Game 5 Sat. in SA.

headlines.headline: MAHOMES EXTENDED THROUGH 2033 FOR $504.75M AS SEAHAWKS HOST SUPER BOWL RING CEREMONY
headlines.detail: Chiefs add two years to Mahomes' deal. Seahawks wrap minicamp and host SB LX ring ceremony celebrating Feb's 29-13 win over NE. 1st-round pick Jadarian Price signed; full draft class under contract.

headlines.headline: UW HUSKIES LAND 3-STAR EDGE CHAZ GRAY OVER TENNESSEE, CLEMSON, AND OHIO STATE
headlines.detail: Gray (St. Joseph Regional, NJ) is No. 33 nationally at edge by 247Sports — UW's 18th commit in '27 class. 4-star WR Tre Moore (TX) also committed earlier in June over OSU and Miami.

headlines.headline: SUMMER RECRUITING HEATS UP — PROGRAMS FINALIZING ROSTERS AHEAD OF JULY EVALUATION PERIOD
headlines.detail: UW hired Marquette asst DeAndre Haynes and added LaJuan Watts (Texas Tech) — joins brother DeSean. 2026 commit Lattimore Ford (Mt. Si) inbound. Programs nationwide locking down remaining scholarships.
